title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Company description: SGB Job description: Customer Service Advisor - Newcastle Working Hours: Monday to Friday - Week 1 : 07:00 - 15:30, Week 2: 09:30 - 18:00 + 1 in 2 Saturdays 07:00 - 12:00 (OT) From £27,200, plus an excellent benefits package, including: - In-house training provided to support career progression - 25 days holiday + public holidays which increases with service - Competitive employer pension - Discounts on major retail outlets, including groceries - 4x basic salary life insurance - Eligibility to receive an annual 'Company Success Payment' We have an exciting opportunity for a motivated individual to join our team at Newcastle. As a Customer Service Advisor, you will be at the forefront of customer interaction, and your responsibilities will include building relationships with new and existing customers, coordinating routine servicing, repairs and maintenance, handling queries and raising invoices for work carried out, whilst always keeping our customers up to date. You will have a real passion for delivering a first-class service and an organised approach to your work. Key Responsibilities: - Meet and greet all customers on arrival in a professional and friendly manner. - Manage day to day administrative tasks confidently and efficiently. - Use initiative and be comfortable working as an individual. - Plan, schedule, and coordinate work. - Create and process job cards, checking for existing work in progress. - Check account detail, available credit and obtain relevant authorisation. - Provide timely updates to our customers. - Agree timescales for unscheduled work and follow through to completion. If you are interested in this exciting opportunity, please apply today. Closing Date: 27/11/2026 Please note, the closing date for this role is subject to change pending volume of applications. Next Steps: - If you like the sound of this position, please apply today. - Your application will be reviewed by the hiring manager or a member of the Scania Recruitment Team. - If you are successful at this stage, you will be invited to have a conversation and discuss the role further. We understand that every candidate is unique, and we strive to accommodate your needs. If you require any adjustments during the application process, please reach out to our Recruitment Team, we'll be happy to discuss these with you.

title: Customer Service Administrator
description: Rewards & Benefits on Offer; - Immediate start date available - Permanent opportunity after successful 12 weeks - Competitive salary - Monday - Friday working hours - Friendly and supportive working environment - Easily accessible offices Working Hours; - Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm The Company you will be working with; MTrec Commercial are proudly representing our prestigious client on their search to appoint an experienced Customer Service Administrator to join their customer services team. This pivotal role requires strong focus on ensuring access and supply of our products with a high service standard. For a customer portfolio, you will be the key actor of all customer-facing operations, ensuring that every interaction is seamless, efficient and customer centric. If you have the required skills and experience, then please apply for an immediate response. The Role you will be doing; - Data processing: Receive, process, and manage customer orders accurately and efficiently, including order entry, verification, and confirmation. - Internal/External Communication: Assist and provide accurate information to customers regarding products, services, pricing, policies, and procedures, addressing any questions or uncertainties to ensure clarity and understanding. Liaise regularly with Warehouse, Planning, Quality Lab and any other relevant departments to ensure on time deliveries. - Issue Resolution: Investigate and resolve customer complaints or issues effectively, employing problem-solving skills, empathy, and diplomacy to achieve satisfactory outcomes and maintain positive customer relationships. - Documentation and Recordkeeping: Maintain comprehensive and organized records of customer interactions, transactions, inquiries, and resolutions using designated systems, ensuring data accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with privacy regulations. - Order Processing: Monitor the status of orders throughout the fulfillment process, liaising with relevant departments to ensure orders reach customers within specified timeframes. Consolidate, monitor and analyse any KPI's (such as On Time Delivery, etc ) - Process Improvement: Analyze feedback from customers regarding their experiences, preferences, and suggestions, actively listening and taking part of continuous improvement and service enhancement. Take an active part in any process improvments or in creating/updating process documentation as needed. - Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with internal departments such as sales, operations, finance and IT to address customer needs, resolve issues, and facilitate seamless communication and workflow. - Invoice & Billing Support: Support any statements or documents clarification upon customer request. Analyse and solve any discrepencies to support orders, terms, and pricing agreements. - Quality Assurance: Conduct quality checks documents and data entries to identify errors, discrepancies, or irregularities, and take corrective actions to resolve issues and prevent recurrence. - Training and Development: Take training courses to enhance the skills, knowledge, and performance of front office staff, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement. - Presentation Skills: Ability to present a business subject with the needed structure or related tools (MS Office), to internal employees or customers. - Perform any other duties deemed relevant to the position About You; - Resilient, adaptable and results driven - Able to learn new activities or business (incl. basic technical or industrial data) - Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, ability to prioritise. - Good communication with ability to convey information professionally to diverse audiences - Customer-first mindset, both internally and externally - Strong interpersonal skills, including empathy, patience, and tact - Drive change, work on own initiative - Promote teamwork - Keen attention to detail
